note: A curated index of widely-used Markdown documents. Every entry points at a public repository; Quire fetches the file directly from that source at install time and never mirrors or hosts it. Submissions are pull requests to this file.

categories.label: Agent config
categories.blurb: Files coding agents read before they touch your repo.

categories.label: Skills
categories.blurb: Reusable capabilities you can drop into an agent.

categories.label: Collections
categories.blurb: Curated lists worth reading end to end.

categories.label: Conventions
categories.blurb: Formats and specs for writing these files well.

entries.title: Karpathy CLAUDE.md
entries.description: A single CLAUDE.md that shapes Claude Code's behaviour, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations about how coding agents go wrong.

entries.title: Karpathy CURSOR.md
entries.description: The same guidance adapted for Cursor. Useful side by side with the Claude version to see what is tool-specific and what is universal.

entries.title: AGENTS.md
entries.description: The open format for telling coding agents how to work in your repository. The canonical file, from the specification itself.

entries.title: DESIGN.md specification
entries.description: A format for describing a visual identity to an agent, so generated UI follows a brand instead of inventing one each time.

entries.title: Awesome Agent Skills
entries.description: Over a thousand agent skills from official dev teams and the community, organised by what they actually do.

entries.title: Awesome Claude Skills
entries.description: A curated list of Claude Skills and the tooling around them, for customising Claude workflows.

entries.title: Claude Code Subagents
entries.description: A hundred-plus specialised subagents covering review, testing, infrastructure and more.

entries.title: Awesome Claude Code
entries.description: A hand-picked collection of Claude Code resources: commands, workflows, configuration and tooling.

entries.title: Awesome Cursorrules
entries.description: Configuration files that shape the Cursor editor's behaviour, grouped by stack and framework.

entries.title: Awesome DESIGN.md
entries.description: DESIGN.md files from well-known brands, analysed. A good way to see what a useful design brief for an agent looks like.

entries.title: AI System Prompts
entries.description: System prompts from major AI tools, collected for study. Useful when writing your own agent instructions.

entries.title: Agent Convention Files
entries.description: A guide to the convention files agents read and write — AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and the rest — and when each one applies.

entries.title: CLAUDE.md Examples
entries.description: Real CLAUDE.md files from working projects, handy for comparing against your own.

entries.title: Backlog.md
entries.description: Managing project collaboration between humans and agents in plain Markdown, which is very much the Quire worldview.
